sections.heading: Open a store on your own site.
body: Sell physical products, digital downloads, and subscriptions from a storefront that’s part of your site — with checkout, POS, and inventory built in.

sections.heading: You don’t need a separate storefront platform bolted onto your site. With Aglyn, your store and your site are the same thing — one design, one login, one checkout.

items.title: Products & variants
items.body: Sell physical, digital, and service products with options, variants, and images.

items.title: Checkout & payments
items.body: Stripe-powered checkout with taxes, discounts, coupons, and gift cards.

items.title: POS & in person
items.body: Ring up sales at the counter with registers; inventory stays in sync (Pro and up).

items.title: Subscriptions
items.body: Offer recurring plans and memberships, billed through Stripe (Business and up).

items.title: Inventory & orders
items.body: Track stock across locations, and manage orders, refunds, and fulfillment.

items.title: Store analytics
items.body: Revenue, orders, average order value, and top products, built in.

sections.heading: Every order, one stream.
body: Orders from your storefront and your POS land in the same place — track status, issue refunds, and keep inventory honest without leaving the console.

items.title: One order stream
items.body: Online and POS orders land in one list, each with status and fulfillment.

items.title: Refunds through Stripe
items.body: Issue refunds in the console; platform fees adjust automatically.

items.title: Inventory that keeps up
items.body: Stock tracked per location, with oversell rules and restock alerts.

items.title: Add products
items.body: Create your catalog with variants, images, and inventory.

items.title: Design your store
items.body: Drop product grids and a cart onto your site in Besigner.

items.title: Start selling
items.body: Connect Stripe, publish, and take orders online or in person.

items.title: Selling starts on Starter
items.body: Open your store on any paid plan — digital fee 5% on Starter, down to 0% on Advanced.

items.title: POS from Pro
items.body: Ring up in-person sales with 1 register on Pro, 2 on Business, 5 on Advanced.

items.title: Physical fees drop fast
items.body: 2% on Starter, then 0% from Pro up — payments through your own Stripe account.

items.title: Media
items.body: A real DAM — folders, drag-and-drop, metadata.

items.title: Analytics
items.body: Privacy-first traffic, top pages & store revenue.

sections.heading: Open your store on Aglyn.
body: Free to start — add products and open your store in minutes.
